action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 search over all legal White moves to find best replies to Black's e4 advance.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search so candidate_moves must be empty. Black shoved e5-e4 attacking the f3 knight; need full coverage to identify safe retreats (Nfd2/Nh4/Ng5/Nd4/Ne5), center play (d2d4), or development (Bc4/Be2) without losing material at shared depth.
